purpose: Edison Research / SSRS 'Top 50 Podcasts in the U.S.' releases defining the popularity frame (researcher decision 2026-10-02: Edison Top 50; Health & Fitness, Self-Improvement and Comedy; all episodes in the past five years).
compiled_from: SSRS site search for 'top 50 podcasts' and web searches on 2026-10-02
notes: Releases up to Q3-Q4 2022 rank shows on rolling survey data of listeners aged 18+ ('Podcast Consumer Tracking Report'); from Q2 2023 each list covers one quarter of listeners aged 13+ and later includes watching. Rankings are therefore not strictly comparable over time.
The full 50-show lists are published as images; only the top 10 appear as page text.
No release covers Q1 2023 alone: the Q3-Q4 2022 list is followed by Q2 2023.
Snapshots 20261002T191005Z and 20261002T191202Z are superseded because of the 2023Q3 source problems above; they are kept unchanged for provenance.

On 2026-10-03 the researcher extended the frame to 2019, so the five releases before Q4 2021 were added (2019 Top 10, Q3 2019 - Q2 2020 Top 30, 2020 Top 50, Q2 2021 and Q3 2021 Top 50; found via SSRS pages and web search on 2026-10-03). No separate Q1 2021 release was found.

releases.note: Top 30 only; survey period Q3 2019 - Q2 2020.

The live Q3 2023 page now redirects to the Q1 2026 page (snapshot 20261002T191005Z), and Edison's file 'Top-50-Podcasts-in-the-US-Q3-2023.pdf' actually contains the Q2 2023 press release (snapshot 20261002T191202Z). The Internet Archive copy of the original page (captured 2023-11-30) is used instead.
